integrity: The proof is analytic, uses the spectral theorem and equality cases in fibrewise norm estimates, and does not use finite numerical experiments as a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: The criterion uses the commutative functional-calculus structure generated by \(|A^*|\) and does not address arbitrary noncommuting block matrices. An older equivalent decomposable-operator formulation remains a residual literature risk.
title: Spectral-mass criterion for norm attainment in a structured block operator matrix
